title: Rewriter (rule-based)
description: Tightens wordy phrases, converts prose to bullets, formalises or simplifies it with a fixed rule set. Deterministic: the same text always gives the same output, nothing is sent to a model, and no download is needed.
x-privacyfold-engine: none (plain JavaScript in the browser tab)

input.description: Text to process. Sent to the tool only through the URL fragment / local input.
